verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a cloud payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency for transaction or shopper data. The local-network versus cloud integration option is a communication architecture choice, not data residency, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
